about: The evangelium of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they could go and anoint Jesus. And very early in the morning on the first day of the week they come to the tomb, the sun already risen. And they were saying to one another: Who will roll the stone away for us from the entrance of the tomb? And looking up, they saw the stone rolled away. For it was very large. And entering the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right, dressed in a white robe, and they were astonished. He says to them: Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He has risen. He is not here. Look at the place where they laid Him. But go, tell His disciples and Peter that He goes ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him, as He told you.

a.g: you seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified

ex.w025: Orto sole is an ablative absolute: it is the sun that has risen.
